name: The Parking Lot Problem
author: EricMan10
description:
Some trucks are parked in parking bays in A. Unfortunately, they have to be moved to lane C. Trucks can only move to a parking space of their own color. You can only move one truck at a time. Use arrow keys and enter to select and move the trucks. Press R to restart. 

Robertson, S. I. (2017). Problem Solving: Perspectives From Cognition and Neuroscience. https://eds.p.ebscohost.com/eds/ebookviewer/ebook/bmxlYmtfXzE0MTc0NTRfX0FO0?sid=d2c78202-03b5-43b4-a71d-7fe4f2e99083@redis&vid=6&format=EB
